post.title: [Hiring] Canadian Graphic Designer needed for photography logo
post.body:
Hey everyone,

I’m looking for a talented Canadian graphic designer to bring a photography logo concept to life. I already have a clear picture in mind of what I want, I just need someone with the technical skills to execute it professionally.

What I need:

* A primary colored version and a black and white version.
* High-resolution files suitable for large-format print (watermarking photos, business cards, signage).
* Web-ready formats optimized for my portfolio site and social media.

What I’ll provide:

* A detailed visual idea/sketch.
* Specific font names to use.
* Exact color codes (HEX/CMYK).
* approximently $100-$300

If you are based in Canada, please drop a link to your portfolio and your preferred way to connect (or DM me directly with your rates/turnaround time).

Thanks!

analysis.summary: Seeking a Canadian graphic designer to create a photography logo in primary and black-and-white versions for print and web use.
